name: Half Marathon Preparation
description: A personal goal expressed as a GOAL model: complete a half marathon in under 2 hours.

states.description: The runner completes 5 km in about 32 minutes and has never run more than 10 km.
The runner finishes a certified half marathon course in under 2 hours.

goals.statement: Complete a half marathon in under 2 hours.

successCriteria.description: Official race results show a finish time under 02:00:00.

goals.statement: Complete two strength training sessions per week for the entire training block.

successCriteria.description: Training log shows >= 2 strength sessions in at least 90% of training weeks.

goals.statement: Build a base of running 25 km per week for 4 consecutive weeks without injury.

successCriteria.description: Running app logs >= 25 km in each of 4 consecutive weeks.

goals.statement: Complete one 18 km long run at target race pace minus 30 seconds per km.

successCriteria.description: A logged run of >= 18 km at average pace <= 5:40 min/km.

goals.statement: Reduce weekly volume to under 15 km in the final two weeks before race day.

successCriteria.description: Training log shows weekly totals under 15 km for the two weeks preceding the race.

goals.statement: Establish a fueling strategy that avoids hitting the wall after 15 km.

successCriteria.description: At least three long runs completed using a consistent fueling plan with no reported energy crash.
successCriteria.evidence: Run notes attached to training log entries

obstacles.description: History of knee pain when weekly volume exceeds 30 km.

constraints.description: No more than 6 hours per week available for training.
Stop increasing volume immediately if knee pain persists more than 2 days.
